And what will this sequencer need to do?''"<br />"''Be able to override the security protocol in a droideka at the Labs.|A spacer and [[Tanoa Vills]]|<ref name="SWG:GtTV">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Legacy|Go to Tanoa Vills|Naboo}}</ref>}}
A '''sequencer''' was a type of technology used in [[security beacon]]s. It permit the security beacons to target efficiently specific security systems.<ref name="SWG:ORDMTD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Legacy|Old Republic Droid Modules: The Droideka|Naboo}}</ref> Components of a sequencer included [[fractal transmitter]]s, [[XJ5 circuit board]]s and [[octave regulator]]s.<ref name="SWG:GtTV" /> Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a spacer used a sequencer into a security beacon in order to override the security protocol of a [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]] studied at [[Stonewall Labs]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and retrieve an experimental [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] module.<ref name="SWG:ORDMTD" />
